usernames.title: Instagram usernames or profile URLs
usernames.description: One per line. Accepts a username (nasa), an @handle (@nasa) or a profile URL (https://www.instagram.com/nasa/).

includePosts.title: Include recent posts
includePosts.description: Also return the newest posts with like/comment counts and an engagement rate. Uses instagram.photos (2 credits per profile) instead of instagram.profile (1 credit).

postsLimit.title: Posts per profile
postsLimit.description: Only used when "Include recent posts" is on. Up to 60.

apiKey.title: Scrape Everything API key
apiKey.description: Your key from https://scrapeeverything.com/?utm_source=apify&utm_medium=actor (new accounts get 100 free credits). Stored encrypted. Leave empty only if the SCRAPEEVERYTHING_API_KEY environment variable is set on the actor.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many API requests run in parallel. The free plan allows 5 concurrent requests, paid plans 20.

cacheDays.title: Accept cached data up to (days)
cacheDays.description: If set (1-14), the API may return a result you already fetched within this many days. Cache hits cost 0 credits. 0 = always fetch live.
